method: Paper iron flies, 2026-11-20 expiry. Spot from 30-min equity bars (regular hours); close_1119 = close of the 11/19 bar beginning 20:30Z. Body K = listed strike nearest close_1119. Entry = closes of the 11/19 20:30Z option bars; straddle_entry = K call + K put at entry. Wings at K -/+ 1x and 2x straddle, nearest listed strikes; width = wider side. exit_spot and option exits use the open of the 11/20 bar beginning 15:00Z (07:00 PT). credit = shorts - longs at entry; exit_cost = shorts - longs at exit; pnl_usd = (credit - exit_cost) x100, capped to [-(width-credit)x100, credit x100]; max_loss_usd = (width-credit)x100. move = exit_spot / close_1119 - 1.
